review_description: You gave me excellent information for me to choose best system
Was a pleasure to deal with Thirroul Solar. Nice people and great service.

Roger, offered advice on the size of system that best suited our needs. Then he went through the features and reliability of the various Solar Panels and Inverters. We selected 260 Watt Trina panels and a Fronius 3.5-1 Inverter. At no time did Roger attempt to pressure us and welcomed any questions we had. Roger was punctual and set up the system so that we could monitor its performance via our IPad.
The salesman from Marks Group visited me but did not follow up by providing written quote.
